name: 粉豹纹滑雪套装
description:
粉色豹纹拼黑色的滑雪套装：外套 + 雪裤。袖子和肩膀是粉豹纹，胸前、袖子上有好几枚小徽章，雪裤两侧有粉豹纹条纹。版型宽松，好叠穿也好活动，单板、双板都适合，平时冬天也能穿。

## 面料与科技
- 3L 复合面料，三层防水压合：外层防泼水，中间 TPU 防水膜，内层加固底布
- 防水指数 ≥15000mmH₂O
- 透湿量 ≥15000 g/m²·24h，排汗透气
- 接缝压胶，耐磨

## 设计细节
- 粉豹纹拼黑色，配多枚徽章贴
- 雪裤两侧粉豹纹条纹
- 宽松版型，里面好叠穿，动作不受限
- 只能手洗，不可漂白、熨烫，不用柔顺剂，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
A pink leopard and black two-piece snow suit: jacket + pants. Pink leopard sleeves and shoulders, a bunch of fun patches on the chest and sleeves, and pink leopard stripes down the pant legs. Relaxed fit that layers easily and moves freely — great for snowboarding or skiing, and cute enough for everyday winter wear.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3-layer bonded waterproof fabric: water-repellent outer layer, TPU waterproof membrane, reinforcing base layer
- Waterproof rating ≥15,000 mmH₂O
- Breathability ≥15,000 g/m²/24h, wicks away sweat
- Bonded seams, abrasion-resistant

## Design Details
- Pink leopard and black color-blocking with lots of patches
- Pink leopard stripes down the sides of the pants
- Relaxed fit for easy layering and unrestricted movement
- Hand wash only; no bleach, ironing or fabric softener; hang dry in the shade

name: 梦幻粉蝴蝶结滑雪套装
description:
白粉色滑雪套装：宽松连帽外套 + 工装雪裤，满身粉色、浅蓝色的蝴蝶结印花，软萌又梦幻。单板、双板都适合。

## 面料与科技
- 3L 防水面料，内里毛绒保暖层
- 防水指数 15000mm，雨雪都不怕
- 透湿量 15000 g/m²，排汗透气
- 防水拉链

## 设计细节
- 加厚防风帽檐，帽子更挺括
- 腋下透气系统，热了可以散热
- 腰部防雪裙
- 亲肤毛绒抽绳，可调松紧
- 大容量口袋
- 只能手洗，不可漂白、熨烫，不用柔顺剂，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
A white-and-pink snow suit: relaxed hooded jacket + cargo pants, covered in pink and baby-blue bow prints — soft, dreamy and sweet. Great for snowboarding or skiing.

## Fabric & Tech
- 3L waterproof fabric with a plush insulated lining
- Waterproof rating 15,000 mm for snow and rain
- Breathability 15,000 g/m² to manage moisture
- Waterproof zippers

## Design Details
- Thickened windproof hood brim that holds its shape
- Underarm ventilation to cool down
- Powder skirt at the waist
- Soft, skin-friendly plush drawcords
- Roomy pockets
- Hand wash only; no bleach, ironing or fabric softener; hang dry in the shade
